_note: Gate 3 (Refine) configuration for feature product-doc. Pairing (intent SSOT): pst_section_registry_url → 20-product-spec-section-registry.json intent chain PB→RN→GO→UR→SN→SC→IO→FL→NG→AC. Pairing (KW SSOT): pst_section_kw_criteria_url → 21-product-spec-section-kw-criteria.md per-section KW0–KW4 rows. Gate 3 coverage axis is narrow (6 sections): timing, users, scenarios, flow, exclusions, acceptance — mirroring design's peel of shape-level sections (GO/SC/NG analog) to Gate 1. Peeled PB/GO/SC/IO still appear in product-doc via Initializing. Two axes: (1) coverage_sections breadth; (2) per-section KW gradient (default leave at KW3). Frontier sweep; methods discover; KW qualifies.

shape_extraction._note: Gate 1 only. Coarse product shape (architecture_view in DQI). Peeled from Gate 3: PB←as_is, GO←to_be, SC←scope.In, IO←affected_files (optional). scope.Out seeds NG but NG stays in Gate 3 for row-level exclusions. Shape constraints gate discovery on the 6 coverage sections.

as_is.label: As-Is (Problem / PB altitude)
as_is.present_as: As-Is → To-Be (paired before→after block with to_be)
as_is.guidance: Registry PB intent: core problem plus verified situational facts (not guesses); must trace to decision-doc. PB is peeled — this field is the PB section substance for Initializing.
as_is.carrier: short narrative block or bullet list
forbidden: goal tables or quantified outcomes (belongs in to_be / GO)
why-now urgency without basis (belongs in RN — Gate 3)
user role lists (belongs in UR — Gate 3)

to_be.label: To-Be (Goal / GO altitude, coarse)
to_be.present_as: As-Is → To-Be (paired before→after block with as_is)
to_be.guidance: Registry GO intent at shape altitude: observable before→after or success state aligned with decision-doc; verifiable in principle by AC. GO is peeled — GO section prose expands in Initializing/FreeEdit, not Gate 3.
to_be.carrier: short narrative block or two-column before→after table
forbidden: capability or I/O lists (belongs in scope / SC / IO)
acceptance item lists (belongs in AC — Gate 3)

scope.label: Change scope (capability-level)
scope.guidance: Capability-level In (SC enumeration seed — SC peeled, lands in Initializing) and Out (coarse exclusion seed for NG). Gate 3 NG refines row-level exclusions against this Out list; do not duplicate SC feature enumeration here.

affected_files.label: Affected surfaces (coarse)
affected_files.guidance: Optional coarse hint for IO section: user-visible surfaces (screens, workflows, channels) — one line each. IO peeled — full I/O object model in Initializing/FreeEdit.
forbidden: full I/O object model with SC mapping (belongs in IO section)

spine.label: Spine
spine.guidance: One line: center of gravity — product outcome this spec must deliver (PB problem → GO success).

traces_to.label: traces_to
traces_to.guidance: Reference label(s) into upstream decision-doc (bet, direction, or goal id) — mandatory anchor.

expose_axis._note: coverage_sections = Gate 3 breadth axis only (6 sections, NOT full registry). Peeled: PB, GO, SC, IO — see shape_extraction.peeled_from_gate3. Default sweep order follows intent chain among listed sections: RN→UR→SN→FL→NG→AC. Full product-doc still uses all registry keys via Initializing.
expose_axis.level_clear_semantics: KW SSOT: fetch pst_section_kw_criteria_url via $FETCH_COMPOSE --role section-kw-criteria before Gate 3. Each ## {section_key} block defines KW0–KW4 for that section only. Default leave at KW3. Iteration unit = one open point.

methods._note: Discovery ACTION for the 6 coverage sections only. subtract shape_constraints (from G1) before registering EPs.

trigger_gap.finds: Registry RN: missing or unverifiable trigger, urgency, or window — or inconsistent with G1 as_is (PB) / decision-doc timing (PB operationalize)

user_scenario_gap.finds: Registry UR/SN: users, roles, or situations from PB/decision-doc without concrete persona, scenario narrative, or reproducible example (UR operationalize → SN operationalize)

flow_gap.finds: Registry FL: no happy-path (entry, main steps, exit/goal-reached) when G1 to_be or SN scenarios imply user flow; references G1 scope for capability context, not SC enumeration

exclusion_gap.finds: Registry NG: exclusion row missing, overlaps G1 scope Out, or fails to protect a GO/SC boundary named in decision-doc or shape_constraints (NG respect_exclude; GO/SC substance from G1/Init)

acceptance_gap.finds: Registry AC: G1 to_be or FL outcome without observable acceptance row, or AC item without trace-back to to_be/FL when decision-doc names goal or flow ids (AC←GO via G1 to_be; FL decompose)

deferred._note: Post-MVP. IO/SC detail discovery or domain-specific methods — re-enable via domain_profiles without changing gate spine.
deferred.domain_profiles: future: e.g. expand coverage_sections with SC/IO when decision-doc is thin
